summary: Veterans Day: the US bond market is closed, stocks are open, no US data. Futures bounce after Tuesday's hot-CPI dip on CoreWeave's Q3 beat (revenue $3.66B, +168% y/y, backlog $132.5B, 2026 guidance raised; CRWV +15% pre-market, NBIS +11%, IREN +8%): Nasdaq-100 futures +1.9%, S&P +0.9%, Dow +0.1%. Pre-market 07:48 ET (Yahoo quotes; Webull is not authorized this morning and Alpaca IEX prints nothing before 08:00, so the ETF and single-stock numbers are Yahoo's pre-market prints vs Tuesday's close): SPY 756.83 (+0.91%), QQQ 688.08 (+1.97%), SMH 507.36 (+4.9%), NVDA 175.77 (+4.1%), AMD 546.84 (+6.1%), TSM 415.88 (+4.9%), INTC 62.01 (+6.7%), GEV 852.00 (+6.9%), MSFT 535.70 (+0.5%), AMZN 271.13 (+0.1%), AAPL 346.33 (-0.63%). Chips bounce as a group in a turning theme (Kospi +2.4%, Taiex +3.6%, SK Hynix +5.5%, Samsung +3.6%, Infineon +6.3%, ASML +3%); NVDA rebounds despite a Baird downgrade to Neutral ($200 from $500, 'supply issues', 07:02), the Reuters report of H200 chips at a PLA-linked Chinese university and senators calling for the CEO to resign. Platforms lag: AAPL -0.6% despite China Renaissance upgrading it to Buy from Hold (06:31, Benzinga; not found on a second source before 08:00), AMZN flat on a report (04:48) that banks weigh pricing the Anthropic IPO above a $1.5T valuation. GEV +6.9% on Siemens Energy's record quarter (read-through), against Ontario Power Generation citing GE Vernova Hitachi engineering delays at Darlington (07:32); VST delays its Helix capital contribution (07:32). Rates (Tuesday cash close, no cash trading today): 2Y 4.74% (+17 bp), 10Y 4.99% (+11 bp, briefly above 5%), the weakest 10Y auction since June; a December hike is ~90-100% priced after Waller ('50 bp worth considering') and Logan ('at least two more'); MOVE 92. Dollar up Tuesday (USDJPY 158.5-159, EURUSD under 1.115). Brent $92.2-92.5 (+0.8%, Hormuz attacks after a two-day drop on Trump playing down more Iran strikes), WTI $86.5; gold $4,055; VIX 18.45 (-5%), VIX1D 13.95, options price ~0.65% for SPY today. Asia: Nikkei +1%, Kospi +2.4%, Taiex +3.6%, Hang Seng -0.7%; Europe: Stoxx 600 +0.3%, DAX +0.7%, banks +1.7%; SoftBank -3% on a 1.12T yen loss. Call: none, p_up 0.53 for the close above the open. A +0.9% gap is the news itself (OVERNIGHT.md: the night move barely predicts open to close); the bounce is in a turning theme after a -0.4% / -0.7% day, the rates driver is switched off for a day (bond market shut: no relief, no shock), and Thursday's claims and 30Y auction and Friday's PPI are the next waves. Neither 0.60 nor 0.40 is reachable. 08:30 re-read (Yahoo quotes 08:30-08:31 and Alpaca IEX prints 08:2x-08:30 vs Tuesday's close): SPY 757.10 (+0.94%; IEX 757.23), QQQ 687.96 (+1.96%), SMH 506.68 (+4.8%), IWM 283.24 (+0.95%, IEX), USO 142.60 (+0.8%); NVDA 174.93 (+3.6%), INTC 61.75 (+6.2%), AMD 543.26 (+5.4%), MU 779.13 (+7.5%, SK Hynix +5.5% overnight), AVGO 346.61 (+4.4%), ORCL 124.15 (+5.2%, no headline checked), CRWV 56.61 (+16%), META 649.68 (+1.3%), TSLA 386.22 (+1.7%), AAPL 347.08 (-0.41%). The gap held through the half hour; nothing changes the call. AAPL upgrade now confirmed on a second source: Yahoo's rating table lists China Renaissance, Upgrade to Buy, price target $425, dated 11-11.

CoreWeave Q3 (Tuesday after the close): revenue $3.66B vs $3.55B expected (+168% y/y), adjusted operating income $379M vs $234M, backlog $132.5B, FY26 revenue and operating income guidance raised; CEO: 'breakout quarter', nearly $10B revenue opportunity from older NVIDIA GPUs. CRWV +15% pre-market, NBIS +11.4%, IREN +7.9%: the neocloud read-through is the day's catalyst for chips.

Reports 11-17 (4 trading days). ANALYST.md: downgrades do not carry.

AAPL: China Renaissance upgrades to Buy from Hold (06:31, Benzinga; the same broker cut it to Hold in August; confirmed at 08:31 on Yahoo's rating table with a $425 target). -0.63% pre-market, -0.41% at 08:31, while QQQ +2%: the upgrade is not in the price and money is flowing from the havens into chips (the 2026-10-15 lesson in reverse). ANALYST.md: AAPL is the weakest upgrade name in the table (21 events, 11 upgrades, median open to close 0.0%, 52% up), so confidence stays at 0.25. Reported 10-29/30: outside the report window.

AMD +6.1% pre-market: Goldman calls chip stocks 'oversold' with names to buy (Yahoo, overnight; list not confirmed), Freedom Capital initiates at Buy (07:31, small broker), AMD-Samsung partnership for semiconductor manufacturing test infrastructure (06:32), Tuesday's $2.5B Anthropic IPO investment. DOSSIER_AMD: Wednesday is its most volatile day with same-day options; an up gap >= 2% continues 64% but calls bought at 09:45 lost (-40%/trade): the gap is spent on arrival. Too big a gap for the sniper.

INTC +6.7% with no headline of its own found (Yahoo news page, Benzinga feed): sector sympathy, a question mark, not a catalyst.

GEV +6.9% pre-market: Siemens Energy posted record quarterly revenue of 12.83B euros this morning (read-through to gas turbines and grid), RWE +1.4%; against it, Ontario Power Generation cites GE Vernova Hitachi engineering delays at the Darlington SMR project (07:32), GLJ Sell reiterated Tuesday, and Tuesday's SoftBank turbine-agreement modification. Two-day whipsaw (-9% open Tuesday, close at the high, +7% today): no pick either way, logged as an opportunity. VST: delays its capital contribution to the Helix AI infrastructure platform (07:32), -2% Tuesday; power theme neutral with REL_WEAK + BREADTH turn flags.

MSFT +0.5% pre-market after -2.2% Tuesday: 'Anthropic launches Claude Sheets to rival Excel' / 'takes aim at Office work' (04:59-07:xx) is a competitive negative on a turning software theme; the stock is not reacting pre-market. Put mirror candidate intraday if QQQ gives back the gap, not a pre-market pick (puts need a SPY put day).

WMT: Baird raises its target to $140 from $120 (06:31) after Mizuho $135 (Tuesday) and UBS $149 (Monday). Three target raises in three days: SUNDAY_TESTS 57 class 'target raise only' (11-09 WMT sniper went flat, the real 131C is -65%): opportunity, not sniper. WMT reports around 11-19 (pre-earnings drift window, RUNUP.md +1.6% median vs SPY).

Anthropic IPO: report (04:48) that banks weigh pricing above a $1.5T valuation, raising over $100B on strong demand; roadshow this week, pricing expected before Thanksgiving. AMZN (largest outside holder) +0.1% pre-market: Tuesday's 10:18 AMZN pick on the same story faded (-0.3%, the 277.5C -64%), day three of the story: opportunity only. Other side: Anthropic's workplace tools are the MSFT negative above.

Rotation (Alpaca daily bars to 11-10, 1w / 1m): internet +4.3% / -5.4% (AMZN +8.0, AAPL +5.0, META +3.3, GOOGL +2.6, MSFT +2.3 on the week), consumer +3.2% / +11.8% (HD +5.2, COST +4.6), banks +1.7% / +0.7%, health +1.5% / +12.7% (LLY +1.6 / +21.1); industrials -0.8% / -5.8% (GE +5.4 vs CAT -6.3), energy -6.8% / -4.0%, power -9.6% / -18.5%, and every chip link down on the week: GPU -18.3% / -25.4%, memory -19.4% / -34.4%, disk -17.0% / -29.3%, optical -11.6% / -37.0%, custom/foundry -4.1% / -19.7%, CPU -2.6% / -28.3% (AMD +6.5 the exception); SPY -0.6% / -3.6%, QQQ -1.5% / -9.6%, SMH -6.7% / -18.2%, IWM +0.3% / +1.0%. THEMES (--today, bars to 11-10): chips and software turning; consumer and industrials heating; internet neutral with REL_STRONG; banks neutral with BREADTH_UP + RATIO_HIGH; health, energy, power, optical neutral.

Mechanical rules today (Wednesday, no release, not opex week): spy_open_drive and spy_open_drive_put (SPY +/-0.5% from its open at 10:00), stock_open_drive (NVDA/TSLA >= +0.8% from the open at 10:00), nvda_gapdown_put (NVDA is gapping up: unlikely), rebound_scanner (no >= 2% down gap visible in its universe pre-market: AAPL -0.6% is the only red mega cap), leader_follow 09:45, meta_follow2 (Wed), the two hero shadows. Operational note from the other Claude (2026-11-10 reply): on expiry day Alpaca liquidates in-the-money option positions itself from about 15:30 ET (accounts cannot exercise) and rejects the holder's later sell. Our real exits run at 15:45; with 0.35-delta contracts an ITM finish is now likely, so today's 16:35 review checks how the bot's exit path handled it (bot.py checks broker positions before selling) and whether a 15:25 real exit for same-day expiries is needed.

opportunities.why: Put mirror conditional: a +4.9% gap in a turning theme after a -6.7% week. Arms only if SMH is back below its open by 11:00; the name is the weakest chip below its open (INTC and NVDA carry the least own news). Base rate: turning-theme gap-ups still closed up 56-60%.
opportunities.why_zh: 看跌镜像条件：半导体 ETF 在转向主题里高开 4.9%。只有 11:00 前它跌回开盘价下才触发，名字是跌破开盘价最弱的那只（英特尔、英伟达自己的消息最少）。基准：转向主题的高开仍有 56–60% 收涨。

opportunities.why: Q3 beat and raised 2026 guidance, +15% pre-market (NBIS +11%, IREN +8%): the day's catalyst, not a mega cap and far beyond the gap line; logged for the record.
opportunities.why_zh: CoreWeave 三季度超预期、上调全年指引，盘前 +15%：今天芯片反弹的源头，但不是大盘股、缺口也太大，只记录。

zh.summary: 退伍军人节：债市休市、股市照开、没有数据。昨天 CPI 偏热跌了一天，今早期货反弹：CoreWeave 三季度营收 36.6 亿（+168%）、上调全年指引，盘前 +15%，带动整条芯片链——盘前 07:48（雅虎报价；Webull 今早没授权，Alpaca 的免费源 08:00 前没有盘前成交）：标普 ETF +0.9%、纳指 ETF +2.0%、半导体 ETF +4.9%，英伟达 +4.1%（Baird 却在今早下调到中性、目标价 200；路透说解放军相关大学买到了 H200），AMD +6.1%，台积电 +4.9%，英特尔 +6.7%（没消息），GE Vernova +6.9%（西门子能源创纪录季度）。平台股落后：苹果 -0.6%（中国 Renaissance 上调到买入也没拉动），亚马逊平。利率：昨天 2 年期 4.74%（+17 基点）、10 年期 4.99%（+11 基点，盘中破 5%），12 月加息基本定价，今天债市不开。油 92（+0.8%，霍尔木兹袭击），恐慌指数 18.5（-5%）。亚洲：韩国 +2.4%、台湾 +3.6%；欧洲小涨、银行 +1.7%。 08:30 再读：标普 ETF +0.94%、纳指 ETF +1.96%、半导体 ETF +4.8%，英伟达 +3.6%、英特尔 +6.2%、AMD +5.4%、美光 +7.5%、甲骨文 +5.2%，苹果 -0.4%：缺口守住了，判断不变。
zh.spy: 不做。收在开盘价上的概率 53%：+0.9% 的高开本身就是消息（夜里的涨跌基本不预测开盘到收盘），反弹发生在「转向」的芯片主题里，债市休市一天利率这根线既不会松也不会再紧，周四初请 + 30 年期拍卖、周五 PPI 才是下一波。看涨要 60%、看跌要 40%，今天到不了。
zh.sniper: 苹果看涨，信心 0.25，只记影子。催化剂是它自己的：中国 Renaissance 今早 06:31 把苹果从持有上调到买入（8 月刚下调过；08:31 在雅虎的评级表里确认：上调到买入、目标价 425）。盘前 -0.6% 而纳指 ETF +2%：消息没进价格，钱在从避险股流向芯片反弹——10-15 的教训反过来（芯片的反弹一旦掉头，避险股接流）。为什么只有 0.25：苹果在我们两年的评级研究里是最弱的一只（21 次评级变化，52% 收涨、中位数 0），中型券商的上调也是弱催化剂。没选的：英伟达 / AMD / 台积电 / 英特尔 / GE Vernova 都高开 4–7%、都是反弹或同行消息；沃尔玛只是目标价上调；亚马逊是 Anthropic 故事的第三天；微软看跌要大盘看跌日。机器人 09:31–10:00 只在苹果守住开盘价时记影子，最近到期就是今天。
zh.rotation: 一周看，钱在互联网平台（亚马逊 +8%、苹果 +5%、Meta +3%）、消费（家得宝 +5%、好市多 +5%）、银行和医疗；一个月看，医疗 +13%、消费 +12% 是赢家。降温的还是整条芯片链：一周英伟达 -18%、存储 -19%、硬盘 -17%、光模块 -12%（一个月 -25% 到 -42%），电力 -10%，能源 -7%。主题状态：芯片、软件「转向」；消费、工业「升温」；互联网中性但相对强；银行中性、宽度转好。今天的芯片反弹（盘前 +4% 到 +7%）是转向主题里的反弹：不买同情盘、不追缺口；如果 11:00 前半导体 ETF 跌回开盘价下，看跌镜像在跌破开盘价最弱的芯片股上触发。
